rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: Answering as 内閣総理大臣 on 28 September 2011, 野田佳彦 said that the formation of his cabinet, after the designation vote, was completed on 2 September.

locator.speaker: 野田佳彦 (内閣総理大臣)

rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: He said that he had asked former Prime Minister Kan (菅前総理) in advance to handle matters properly during the interval, when the cabinet would be a continued-duties cabinet (職務執行内閣), and that there had been no gap.

locator.speaker: 野田佳彦 (内閣総理大臣)

bounded_scope: Head-of-government observations for CLAUDE-C01-13 only (stacked on CLAUDE-C01-12).
